description: Full cpu_ops_bench.py suite, default threads (8), perf/cpu 1a27421. 3 rounds, configs interleaved with a rotating start order, 2026-11-15 17:31-17:55 IST. Values are per-run median ms; 'speedup' is median(baseline runs)/median(config runs).
machine: 8 vCPU Intel Xeon VM, Linux, conda-forge GCC 13.4 / libstdc++ 13.4, clang 19.1.7 (conda-forge) using the same GCC 13.4 libstdc++ and sysroot
